# SYNTHETIC phase-2 activation fixture

This registry is test data outside production curated inputs. It assumes a
two-stop bidirectional İnşaatçılar–28 May shuttle at existing walk-access nodes
118425 and 118435 of the hash-bound C4 bundle. Two distinct service variants,
SYN_INS_28_6 and SYN_INS_28_9, share both patterns/stops, with design headways
6 and 9 minutes. Assumed segment distances are 6,000 m each direction; endpoint
lines are schematic synthetic geometry, not researched routes. Mean existing
R2/R14 calibrated speed is used only as an explicit design assumption, not a
published M-line measurement. All synthetic evidence/statuses remain assumptions.

Do not copy this into real curated M assets or imply optimization readiness.
See docs/C5_ACTIVATE_SERVICE.md for the exact schema, hash recipe, access policy,
runtime semantics, commands and limitations. The independent three-stop and new
coordinate-stop cases are constructed in tests/test_activate_service.py.
